description: File-based Kanban boards stored in your workspace.
configuration.globalBoardsFolder: Folder that holds your global Kanban boards (each board is a subfolder with a .kanban directory). Global boards are available in every window, regardless of the open workspace.
tool.listCards: List a board's columns and cards.
tool.createCard: Create a card on a board.
tool.updateCard: Retitle, move or reprioritize a card.
tool.linkCards: Link two cards (blocking, related or parent).
tool.readyCards: List the cards that are ready to work on.
tool.addHandoff: Add a handoff note to a card.
tool.cardContext: Get a card's full context as a resume prompt.
tool.startCoordinator: Decompose a card into a campaign of sub-cards.
configuration.agentsMaxConcurrent: Maximum number of card agents running at the same time.
configuration.agentsUseWorktrees: Run each card agent in its own git worktree (branch card/<id>) when the board lives in a git repository.
configuration.campaignRequireApproval: Ask for confirmation before a campaign dispatches agents.
configuration.campaignTimeoutMinutes: Safety timeout for a campaign, in minutes.
